title: Russia will not play at World Juniors due to Canadian government’s restrictions, IIHF says
content:
Russia will not participate in the upcoming World Junior Championship due to “the position and restrictions formally communicated by the Canadian government,” the International Ice Hockey Federation said Sunday in a statement.

The news comes after the Government of Canada confirmed Wednesday that it would not grant visas to Russian players, staff and officials for the tournament.

“As (Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney) has said, as long as Russia and Belarus are supporting the war in Ukraine, athletes representing those countries will not be permitted to compete for their countries in Canada. With respect to the 2026 World Junior Championship specifically, Russian athletes will not participate,” Adam van Koeverden, Canada’s secretary of state for sport, said in a statement.

This story will be updated.
